scripts.test:unit: npm run docker:clean && npm run test:unit:backend && npm run test:unit:frontend
scripts.smoke:up: docker compose build backend frontend && docker compose up -d && node smoke/utils/wait.cjs
scripts.smoke:scanner: docker compose --profile scanner down -v --remove-orphans && docker compose --profile scanner -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.scanner-smoke.yml build backend frontend scanner_worker && docker compose --profile scanner -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.scanner-smoke.yml up -d && node smoke/utils/wait.cjs && SCANNER_SMOKE=1 npx playwright test -c smoke/playwright.config.cjs --project=chromium scanner.spec.cjs; code=$?; docker compose --profile scanner -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.scanner-smoke.yml down -v --remove-orphans; exit $code
scripts.scanner:local:up: docker compose --profile scanner-local -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.scanner-local.yml up -d --build && node scripts/wait-for-http.cjs http://127.0.0.1:${HOMR_LOCAL_PORT:-8010}/readyz 300000 && node smoke/utils/wait.cjs
scripts.scanner:provider:test: docker compose --profile scanner-local -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.scanner-local.yml exec -T homr_cpu python -m unittest test_homr_provider -v
scripts.scanner:local:down: docker compose --profile scanner-local -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.scanner-local.yml down --remove-orphans
scripts.scanner:local:logs: docker compose --profile scanner-local -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.scanner-local.yml logs -f homr_cpu scanner_worker
scripts.scanner:local:smoke: SCANNER_REAL=1 npx playwright test -c smoke/playwright.config.cjs --project=chromium scanner-real.spec.cjs
scripts.smoke: npm run docker:clean && npm run smoke:up && npm run smoke:install && npm run smoke:run && npm run docker:clean
